name: dsfd_vm_be_sl-r4-COMMIT
purpose: el1011-ds-vm/besl r4: r3 71536bfc4 TT +7.85 / FF -6.57 = 9 endpoints, ALL str_clk->core_clk pointer/state hops (u_rc*.rp->rp_w, r_st->r_st_w): launch cks leaf 219.8 ps vs capture ck leaf 258.7 ps at FF (39 ps inter-tree skew vs 38 ps clk->Q; trees routed str EARLY by 10 TT / 18 FF because r3 balanced the all-register mean one-sided, stop at +12). Post-route hold ECO skipped exactly these (tight: setup +23.9 in the 208 ps 4:3 window) and buffered 9,314 others -> TT -2.36. Fix (tree, not ECO): be_sl_str_boundary.tcl balances on the CROSSING flops (pointer and storage hops weighted equally), two-sided, TT residual (-14,0] ps. No RTL / SDC / pin / outline change vs r3; the kit regenerates at the contract v13 slot cap M6 (coordinator grant 10-12 11:40; ref_tile refuses M5 against the slot), r3 was M5.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_vm_be_sl u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/vm/dsfd_sp_vm.sv && echo lint-ok
